questions.q: Who protected the Prophet SAW even though he did not embrace Islam?
questions.explain: Abu Talib protected him and promised to keep defending him.

questions.q: What was his answer when he was offered great things to stop preaching?
options: He would not stop even if the sun and moon were placed in his hands
questions.explain: He would not stop until he won or perished. That is steadfastness in the call.

questions.q: Why did Quraysh mock that Muhammad was "cut off"?
questions.explain: When his son Abdullah died, Quraysh rejoiced and said Muhammad was cut off.
Al-Kawthar is abundant goodness, including a river and pool in Paradise.

questions.q: Which wealthy, handsome young man of Makkah embraced Islam at Dar al-Arqam?
questions.explain: Mus'ab embraced Islam even under pressure.

options: A Christian land across the sea ruled by a just king
questions.explain: Habasyah was the first place of migration for the Muslims.

options: The son of Al-Walid, called the Sword of Allah
questions.explain: Khalid joined the Prophet SAW even though his father was hostile to him.

questions.q: The Prophet SAW answered insults with harsh words.
questions.explain: False. He stayed gentle and invited them with kindness to be God-fearing.

questions.q: The Prophet's SAW name is mentioned every moment through the adhan, while his enemies' names are forgotten.
questions.explain: True. That is a good name that keeps being mentioned.

questions.q: Put these events in the right order.
questions.explain: Quraysh complained, he refused to stop, Abdullah died, Al-Kawthar was revealed and Mus'ab embraced Islam.

questions.q: Match each term with its meaning.

right.text: The family and descendants of the Prophet SAW
The secret headquarters of the Muslims

questions.explain: Al-Kawthar is abundant goodness, Ahl al-Bayt are the Prophet's family, nahr is sacrificing an offering, and Dar al-Arqam was the secret headquarters.

questions.q: Your friend has lost someone dear. What example does this story give?
options: Stop quarrelling and apologise, not rejoice at his sorrow
questions.explain: Quraysh rejoiced at his grief. We should stop fighting and ask forgiveness.
